page.overview:
What is Battles of Rashfond?

The Battles of Rashfond were a series of battles that were fought by the Jedi Order at Rashfond, sometime prior to the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems. during the Clone Wars, the architect droid professor Huyang recalled the battles while listing conflicts the Jedi had been involved in to a clan of Jedi younglings he was instructing on lightsaber construction, aboard the Jedi training vessel Crucible.

The Battles of Rashfond were mentioned in "A Test of Strength,"
